data.title: [Old Deep Water Dies, by Rising Tide It is Denied] Version Update & Maintenance Preview
data.brief: Dear Endministrator:Arknights: Endfield will undergo scheduled maintenance for a client version upda
data.data:
Dear Endministrator:

Arknights: Endfield will undergo scheduled maintenance for a client version update starting at Mar. 12, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8). Upon completion, the game will be updated to the newest version: [Old Deep Water Dies, by Rising Tide It is Denied].

This update is mandatory. You will not be able to log into the game during the maintenance period; please plan your gaming schedule accordingly. Once the update is complete, you will need to re-download the game client. Due to the large download size, we recommend that you download the update using a stable Wi-Fi connection.


▼// Maintenance Time

Asia Server: Mar. 12, 2026 at 06:00 – Mar. 12, 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+8)

Americas / Europe Server: Mar. 11, 2026 at 17:00 – Mar. 11, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC-5)


▼// How to Update

After maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the in-game instructions to proceed with the update.

· iOS: Enter the App Store and tap "Update"

· Android: Enter the game and follow the pop-up prompts to complete the update

· PlayStation®5: Go to the home screen, select [Arknights: Endfield], press the controller's [OPTIONS] button, select [Check for Update], and confirm the update.

· PC: After closing the game, restart the GRYPHLINK launcher and click "Update"


▼// Update & Maintenance Compensation

· Compensation Details: [Oroberyl]×900

· Distribution Period: After the update and maintenance – Before the next version update and maintenance

· Eligibility: Create a character before the update.

· Note: Compensation will be sent via in-game mail. The mail is valid until the next version update and maintenance begin, so please be sure to claim it in time.


▼// Update & Maintenance Details

This update is mandatory. You will not be able to log into the game during the maintenance period; please plan your gaming schedule accordingly. Once the update is complete, you will need to re-download the game client. Due to the large download size, we recommend that you download the update using a stable Wi-Fi connection. Estimated storage space required to download this update:

· iOS: 9GB (An additional 20GB of free storage is required when extracting files)

· Android: 6GB (An additional 20GB of free storage is required when extracting files)

· PlayStation®5: 37GB (An additional 48GB of free storage is required when extracting files)

· PC: 37GB (An additional 48GB of free storage is required when extracting files. Install the game on an SSD for better gaming experiences.)

※Temporary storage used during extraction will be freed once the extraction is complete.
